scope: Fixed periodic 3D nonlinear isothermal Navier-Stokes plus passive mass transport. GPU sparse products inside CPU conjugate gradients; all other work remains CPU. Heat, buoyancy, growth and calibrated nucleation risk are not implemented by this experiment.
concentration_field: cell average of mean + amplitude * cos(2*pi*x/L) * cos(2*pi*y/L) * cos(2*pi*z/L); chosen numerical verification field, not a measured experiment or equilibrium state
map_definition: max(C - initial_volume_mean_C, 0) / initial_volume_mean_C; dimensionless positive concentration-excess indicator, not a calibrated defect/nucleation probability or supersaturation
warmup: One fresh complete run per backend/grid before three measured fresh runs. GPU pipeline/context construction remains separately included in each cold total. No matrix or factorization cache survives a run.
order: For each grid: warmup CPU then GPU; measured repeats alternate CPU/GPU and GPU/CPU.
interpretation: Report all runs including failures and negative performance. Accuracy criteria are software verification choices frozen before timing. No speedup requirement or physical quality claim. This is a partial HPC deliverable; heat and a physically justified risk map remain open.
